main.description: Crawl US federal statutory material (CFR / USC) from GovInfo bulkdata. Phase 2 MVP ingests CFR title-level metadata from the free JSON index (https://www.govinfo.gov/bulkdata/json/CFR); full title XML parse (part / section / paragraph) follows in a later PR. Writes to vertex_houbun_statute. Public domain.

titleNumber.description: CFR title (1–50) or USC title (1–54). Omit to ingest the full title index.

year.description: Edition year (e.g. 2024 for CFR, 2023 for USC).

limit.description: Max statutes to ingest in one call (default 50, max 500).
